description: This file defines types, interfaces, and a function related to configuration modes and their resolution for a command-line interface (CLI) parser. It provides type definitions for different configuration modes, a union type for resolution results, and a function to determine the appropriate configuration mode based on provided parameters.

methods.name: export function resolveConfigSetMode(params: { resolveConfigSetMode
methods.description: Determines the configuration mode based on input parameters indicating the presence of batch mode, ref builder options, provider builder options, and strict JSON flag. Returns a resolution object indicating success or failure with appropriate error messages.
